subject: AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace private offer unit price mapping & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Morgan <leah.morgan@aws-partner.com>, Procurement BrightCart <procurement@brightcart.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace private offer unit price mapping & next steps

Hi Leah / BrightCart procurement,

Thanks again for the call this morning — really appreciate the time. Quick recap and asks so we can align on the private-offer pricing path for the marketplace listings (AWS / GCP / Azure):

Call recap:
- BrightCart plans to launch LLM-powered chat and generation features in Q3 with an initial pilot (support & search) and ramp to production by Q4.
- Target usage: pilots then scale — see volumes question below.
- Primary purchase preference: marketplace private offers (to use existing procurement flows).

Open asks for pricing/ops modeling:
1) Expected monthly token volumes (pilot -> steady-state). Please give conservative and optimistic estimates.
2) Target net unit economics: target $/1M tokens (what BrightCart wants to pay to Redwood after marketplace fees).
3) Any marketplace constraints (procurement timelines, approvals, required paperwork).

What I propose next (if these align):
- You share volumes + target $/1M tokens (range ok) and any procurement timing.
- We'll produce a private-offer unit-price mapping spreadsheet that converts your target net price into the list price required on each marketplace (AWS, GCP, Azure) accounting for marketplace fees and taxes.
- We'll attach that mapping and an assumptions doc (fees by cloud, commission %, tax treatment) and schedule a 30-min ops call with Marketplace Ops + Procurement to finalize.

I've cc'd Aditya (platform/invoice ops) to help with the fee and billing side.

Attachments: we'll follow up with a draft mapping file once we get your targets - planning to include both per-1M token and per-100K token tiers.

Next steps / ask: can you share the two volume points (pilot / production) and a target net $/1M tokens by end of day tomorrow?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Exec, Revenue
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Leah Morgan <leah.morgan@aws-partner.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement BrightCart <procurement@brightcart.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace private offer unit price mapping & next steps

Thanks Marissa — good call from our side as well. A few quick answers: 

Volumes (monthly token consumption):
- Pilot (Q3): ~50M tokens/month (chat + reranking workload)
- Production (Q4 steady-state): 200M tokens/month (peak forecasts show spiking to 300M for promotional windows)

Budget / target net unit economics:
- Procurement is targeting ~$800-1,100 per 1M tokens net to the vendor (that is what they want Redwood to receive after marketplace fees).
- If I had to pick a single target for modeling: $950 / 1M tokens net.

Marketplace notes:
- BrightCart requires procurement to use private offers on AWS Marketplace where possible; GCP/Azure are acceptable if legal/procurement align similarly.
- Timeline: procurement can review and approve a private offer in ~2-3 weeks once we have a clear SOW and pricing table.

Question: can Redwood produce a mapping that shows the list price we should put in each cloud (AWS / GCP / Azure) so the net Redwood receives is $950 / 1M tokens? Also please show sensitivity for a 12% vs 15% marketplace fee.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — procurement wants the draft mapping before the internal IDT meeting on 4/12.

Leah
Leah Morgan
Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace
leah.morgan@aws-partner.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Morgan <leah.morgan@aws-partner.com>, Procurement BrightCart <procurement@brightcart.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T17:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace private offer unit price mapping & next steps

Thanks Leah — perfect, this is exactly what we need. I've attached a draft mapping and the fees assumptions doc for your review. Summary / highlights below so the team can review quickly: 

Assumptions (attached doc has line-by-line):
- Target net price to Redwood: $950 / 1M tokens.
- Marketplace fee scenarios modeled: 12% and 15% (these cover common AWS/GCP/Azure fee bands for private offers).
- We model GST/VAT outside of vendor net (separate line item) — mapping shows pre-tax list price.

Conversion logic (simple formula):
list_price = target_net / (1 - marketplace_fee_pct)
Example (12% fee): list_price = 950 / (1 - 0.12) = 1,079.55 => round to $1,080 / 1M tokens

Proposed sample unit-price mapping (per 1M tokens):
- AWS (12%): $1,080 / 1M tokens
- GCP (13% modeled): $1,092 / 1M tokens
- Azure (15%): $1,118 / 1M tokens

Notes on rounding / tiers: we recommend publishing list prices in $/1M tokens rounded to nearest $5 to keep tables clean. For customers that buy commit tiers (e.g., 10M+, 50M+), we'll show stepped discounts — mapping file includes per-tier examples.

Attachment list:
- private_offer_price_mapping.xlsx (tabbed: assumptions, per-cloud mappings, tiered discounts)
- marketplace_fees_breakdown.pdf (summary of fee sources, who remits, and where taxes are applied)

Next steps / action items:
1) Leah / Procurement to confirm whether AWS will accept the 12% fee assumption for a private offer (if AWS expects 15% we'll use that mapping).
2) BrightCart to confirm the $950 target or provide a range if they want the mapping run for $800 and $1,100 as well.
3) Once confirmed, we'll schedule a 30-min ops call (Marketplace Ops + Procurement + Redwood billing) to finalize the private offer payload and DocuSign link.

I'll also run the sensitivity for pilot vs production volumes (50M / 200M / 300M) to show total monthly cost to BrightCart at each list price — will circulate that in the next email.

Thanks — leaning on Aditya and Logan for the final invoice & marketplace ops pieces.

Best,
Marissa

Subject: Re: AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace private offer unit price mapping & next steps

Marissa / Leah — quick note from ops side:

I reviewed the mapping and attachments. We can produce the DocuSign-ready private-offer payload once BrightCart confirms the list-price per cloud and the preferred billing entity. A couple operational notes:
- If BrightCart requires invoice lines broken out by model (chat vs embeddings) we'll need to capture token attribution in the payload — doable but requires mapping table of model -> token multiplier (I can draft).
- For the sensitivity sheet, I'll run cost projections at 50M/200M/300M tokens/month showing gross list price, marketplace fee amount, and net to Redwood.

I'll drop the ops deck and the draft private offer payload in the shared drive after this thread. If procurement wants to move quickly we should lock the mapping by 4/08 to meet BrightCart internal approval timelines.

Aditya
